fieldData.short-description: Large hotel portfolio and strong luxury brand precense.
fieldData.program-overview: Marriott Bonvoy is the largest hotel loyalty program in the world, spanning more than thirty brands from Ritz-Carlton, St. Regis, and The Luxury Collection to Courtyard, Moxy, and the extended-stay Residence Inn. Its multi-tier elite structure tops out at the invitation-style Ambassador Elite, which adds a dedicated ambassador and the flexible Your24 check-in benefit. The sheer breadth of the portfolio is its greatest strength, though the size of the program means elite recognition and suite-upgrade delivery can be inconsistent between properties.
fieldData.elite-tiers-description: Six tiers across thirty-plus brands, topping out at the invitation-style Ambassador Elite.
fieldData.name: Marriott Bonvoy

fieldData.short-description: Easy point accumulation and attainable status.
fieldData.program-overview: Hilton Honors is Hilton's loyalty program, covering more than twenty brands worldwide from luxury Waldorf Astoria and Conrad to focused-service Hampton and Tru. It is widely regarded as having one of the most attainable top tiers in the industry, with Diamond status reachable in a single year and free breakfast (or a daily credit) extended to mid-tier Gold members. Upgrades are space-available rather than confirmed, and the program rarely includes guaranteed suite upgrades, but its broad benefits and easy status make it popular with frequent travelers.
fieldData.elite-tiers-description: Four tiers, with the most attainable top tier in the industry and free breakfast extended down to mid-tier Gold.
fieldData.name: Hilton Honors

fieldData.short-description: IHG's loyalty program covering luxury to budget brands.
fieldData.program-overview: IHG One Rewards is InterContinental Hotels Group's loyalty program, spanning a broad portfolio from luxury brands like InterContinental, Regent, and Six Senses down to midscale and budget names like Holiday Inn and Candlewood Suites. Its elite structure rewards both nights and spend, with the top Diamond tier offering the strongest upgrades and recognition. The program is known for its breadth of properties and a milestone-based rewards system, though elite benefit delivery can vary more by property than at some competitors.
fieldData.elite-tiers-description: Five tiers, with Diamond Elite at the top offering the strongest upgrades and recognition across IHG's portfolio.
fieldData.name: IHG One Rewards
